message:
chore(backend): bootstrap the Symfony 7.4 skeleton and dependencies

Composer defines the full dependency set (doctrine, messenger, security,
JWT, phpstan, phpunit) and the Flex recipes generate the kernel and
config. PHPUnit has Unit/Integration/E2E suites; PHPStan runs at level
6. Installed locally with ext-intl ignored, since the real runtime is
the infra container, which has it.

chore(backend): scaffold the hexagonal module layout and deployment modes

Each of the 26 bounded contexts gets a Domain/Application/Infrastructure
layout plus a shared kernel with placeholder aggregate, event and bus
interfaces. The kernel also imports config per APP_ENV and
DEPLOYMENT_MODE (SaaS or dedicated), with a plan-enforcer interface.

chore(backend): add README, php-cs-fixer scripts and Redis, lock and rate limiter wiring

Dev/test setup no longer fights the infra stack: Flex compose recipes
are disabled, and composer gets lint/format/qa scripts. Redis,
symfony/lock and the rate limiter are wired behind lazy factories and
covered by integration tests.
Merge feat/kernel-modes-and-redis: deployment modes and Redis wiring
chore: clean up leftovers from the initial scaffolding
feat(kernel): first pass at the kernel building blocks

feat(envelope): add the envelope schema, mapping and wiring config

First step of the envelope aggregate: Doctrine mappings, the initial
migration, messenger and service config, and the deptrac and phpstan
settings it needs.

feat(envelope): add the envelope domain model and kernel contracts

Envelope aggregate, value objects and events, plus the kernel categories
they are built on.
feat(envelope): add the envelope use cases and their handlers
feat(envelope): add the envelope persistence and infrastructure adapters
test(envelope): cover the envelope aggregate and its adapters
Merge feat/envelope-aggregate: the first envelope aggregate and its tests
chore: small follow-up adjustments

feat(kernel): add CompositeValueObject for embeddable value objects (DI-2)

Doctrine embeddable hydration writes properties through reflection on
the second load, which fails for final readonly classes. A kernel
category for composite value objects avoids it, with a rule that checks
their shape.

refactor(envelope): give Step a surrogate identity

Step is identified by a surrogate StepId; the ordinal becomes a mutable
attribute under UNIQUE(envelope_id, ordinal), and recipients reference
the step by id. The phpstan rule comment now cites the in-repo
convention instead of the old finding ids.
docs(phpstan): update the rule authoring guide and README for the shared helpers

build(phpstan): move the rules onto the shared ClassNodeContext helper

Rules share one helper for resolving the class node being analysed,
instead of each repeating it. Composer and the phpstan config are
updated to match.

test(phpstan): add a reference test for the node-context helper and extend rule tests

Continues the substrate hardening of the custom phpstan rules: the
helper gets a reference test and the existing rule tests are brought
onto it.
Merge feat/phpstan-rule-helpers: shared class-node helper for the custom rules

refactor(phpstan): tighten IssuedConstructorTakesIssuedAtRule

The date check now accepts only a plain \DateTimeImmutable name;
nullable and union forms are rejected. The sibling test covers both
shapes.

docs(adr): move the locked decisions into the in-repo ADR set (ADR-0001 to 0007)

The code repo becomes the home of architecture decisions, so the earlier
locked decisions are promoted here as ADRs.

docs(phpstan): point rule messages and docblocks at in-repo targets

More than half of the rules cited markers from the design repo, which
readers of this repo cannot open. Messages now name an ADR or class in
this tree.

feat(phpstan): check that @see references are fully qualified class names

The kernel concept graph is now walkable by grep: a rule requires every
class reference in @see to be fully qualified, and the spec pointers are
re-homed in the repo. Composer test, phpstan and lint scripts also run
without progress output.

feat(envelope): add the read-side query path and a cross-context error channel

Implements the light CQRS read side (ADR-0008): a same-context
EnvelopeReadRepository returning EnvelopeView, and a cross-context
EnvelopeQueryInterface that exposes an envelope's context to Signature
Execution.

docs: add the in-repo domain models, ADRs 0009 to 0016 and architecture overview

The specification the backend needs now lives next to the code: domain
models, the next batch of ADRs and a one-page architecture overview.

feat(envelope): enforce tenant isolation with row-level security

A migration adds a fail-closed current_tenant_id() function, FORCE
policies and grants for a non-superuser app role. TenantContext and a
messenger middleware set the tenant per request, and an RLS isolation
test covers it.

feat(persistence): add a DBAL-only write adapter and the schema conventions ADR

The Envelope DBAL write adapter was run against the ORM one behind the
same repository port; the suite passed against both (95 tests). The ORM
stays as an alias for now. ADR-0019 records the 11 schema conventions.

feat(kernel): add the EntityReference category for cross-context references (TASK-003)

Realizes the strict anti-corruption layer of ADR-0004 in both directions
between Envelope and Signature Execution. A reference to a foreign
entity is a value object, not an entity.
chore: add cspell configuration

chore(deps): add the JWT and security bundles and E2E test tooling

Dependencies for the upcoming HTTP exposure of the envelope: lexik JWT,
security-bundle, and browser-kit and css-selector for end-to-end tests.

feat(envelope): expose the envelope context over HTTP (ADR-0021, ADR-0022)

First HTTP surface: POST /api/v1/envelopes returns 201 with a Location
and id, and GET /api/v1/envelopes/{id} returns 200 or 404.

feat(se): seal a PDF at PAdES-BASELINE-B with the DSS server keystore

First real cryptography in the backend. Signature Execution gets a DSS
client port and an adapter that signs through the EU DSS server-signing
keystore.

docs: add the deferral backlog index and record each deferral in its ADR or task

The index only points to where each deferred item is decided, so the
decisions themselves live in the ADR or task, such as the external HTTP
retry primitive in ADR-0015.

feat(envelope): seal a real envelope document and rename Innasign to F5Sign

The document's bytes now flow through the backend, are hashed inline and
stored in object storage, and the seal reads the original (ADR-0016,
provisional). The F5Sign rename covers namespaces, composer, deptrac,
phpstan and error-id slugs.

docs(adr): add the open-decisions notes for event delivery (ADR-0024)

Working notes for the event-delivery design, to be retired once ADR-0024
itself is written.

feat(outbox): add the transactional outbox, relay and AMQP delivery (ADR-0024)

One delivery path replaces the in-memory recorder and the synchronous
cross-context dispatch: domain events are written to the outbox in the
same transaction and a relay delivers them over AMQP.

feat(http): emit RFC 9457 errors and publish the OpenAPI docs (ADR-0025, ADR-0026)

The edge returns application/problem+json with type, title, status,
code, detail and errors instead of ad-hoc bodies, and the envelope
routes are documented in the generated OpenAPI spec.

feat(envelope,se): close the signing seal loop over the event consume side

The add-step, add-recipient and send use cases are routed, including
POST /v1/envelopes/{id}/send. Signature Execution now reacts to the
events it consumes, so a sent envelope ends up sealed without a manual
call.

feat(session): add the recipient signing ceremony with token authentication

New Session context for the public, token-authenticated half of the
workflow, feeding the seal loop. The tenant for row-level security is
taken from the credential rather than a header.

build(phpstan): analyse tests at level 9 and fix the findings

Tests are held to the same bar as src. This cleared 220 findings, mostly
in how tests read mocks and untyped values.

feat: map domain exceptions to HTTP status by kind (ADR-0029)

Aggregate guards such as already-signed, incomplete send and missing
envelope were escaping as a generic 500. A DomainException family now
carries the kind, and the edge maps each kind to its status.

feat(kernel): serialize events from the floor and declare the event type (ADR-0030)

First stage of the event-log work (TASK-010): contract preparation on
the outbox with no change to the store or the wire format.

feat(event-log): add the platform.event_log store and its definer append (ADR-0031)

Stage 1a builds the append mechanism and its commitment on their own and
tests them before any producer depends on it. Nothing writes to the log
yet.

feat(event-log): make the log the system of record and retire the synchronous audit path

Stage 1b: producers write to platform.event_log, and delivery becomes a
watermark projection over the immutable log instead of a mutable outbox
state.

feat(event-log): remove the transactional outbox

The log has been the system of record since the previous stage, so the
outbox table and the code that only fed it are dropped in a migration.
Merge feat/event-log: the event log becomes the system of record and replaces the outbox

docs(event-log): align the design docs with the event-log reframe

ADR-0017, ADR-0031, the authoring guide, the evidence-audit model and
TASK-009 and TASK-013 now describe the log as the source of truth.

refactor(event-log): consolidate duplicated seams and clear leftover outbox references

Removes stale outbox wording from .env files and docs, folds six
duplicated seams found in the branch review, and extracts three floor-
accessor traits for events. Behaviour is unchanged; phpstan, deptrac and
cs-fixer are clean and 294 tests pass.

fix(time): store and read every timestamp in UTC

The DBAL repository bound created_at and sent_at through a datetime type
that writes no offset, so with php-fpm on Europe/Madrid and a UTC
database the values were shifted.

feat(envelope): download a document's sealed PDF

GET /api/v1/envelopes/{id}/documents/{documentId}/sealed returns the
sealed PDF as application/pdf, streamed through the backend.

feat(envelope,session): void a live envelope and sign with reservations

POST /api/v1/envelopes/{id}/void moves a sent envelope to VOIDED and
records who, why and when. A signer can also attach a free-text
reservation (eCMR) that travels with their completed outcome as
evidence.

chore(deptrac): make cross-context Contract visibility uniform (ADR-0004)

The deptrac header allowed Application and Infrastructure to import
another context's Contract unconditionally, while the rules did not. The
rules now match ADR-0004.

feat(envelope,se): add the domain model for sequential PAdES signing (ADR-0034)

A per-envelope SigningMode and a per-recipient SigningAssignment decide
which documents a recipient signs and where the marks go. SINGLE_SEAL is
unchanged.

feat(envelope,se): sign each recipient as an incremental PAdES revision

Each signing act appends a revision over the previous byte state, so
tampering with an earlier signature invalidates every later one.
Completion follows RecipientSigned, and the chain-tip append is a
compare-and-swap.
test(envelope,se): cover sequential signing across HTTP, integration and scenarios

test(se): cover incremental sealing and the artifact chain

Integration and unit tests for the Signature Execution side of
sequential PAdES signing.
Merge feat/sequential-pades: each recipient signs as an incremental PAdES revision

docs(testing): adopt the testing standard (ADR-0035) and add Infection

The standard gates structural test strength on Infection's covered MSI,
not a line-coverage percentage, and tiers tests by eIDAS assurance.
ADR-0036 covers type-annotation certainty.

refactor(tests): reshape the Session tests to the size-tier layout (ADR-0035)

Moves only, no behaviour change: 27 tests and 125 assertions before and
after. This is the pilot for the other contexts.

refactor(tests): reshape the Signature Execution tests to the ADR-0035 layout

Files move into the tier directories; the 393 tests and 1372 assertions
are unchanged.

refactor(tests): adopt #[Test] naming and the tier layout in Kernel and Foundation tests

Seventeen test_-prefixed methods in the Kernel become #[Test] with
snake_case names, and Foundation moves into the tiers with its doubles
under Testing/Fake.

refactor(tests): reshape the Envelope tests and move cross-context flows to the top level

Moves only, behaviour unchanged. Flows that span several contexts now
live in the top-level Integration directory.
Merge feat/test-tiers: tests follow the ADR-0035 size-tier layout

feat(phpstan): require Unit and Application tests to be container-free (ADR-0035)

A new HermeticTierRule rejects any test under Unit/ or Application/ that
extends KernelTestCase. The two cross-cutting HTTP tests move to
Acceptance and Integration.

test(envelope,se): add focused Application-tier tests for 18 classes

These classes were only exercised by broad flow tests, so the coverage
attributed to them was indirect. Each now has its own test with
#[CoversClass].

refactor(kernel): move the Clock test doubles out of src

FrozenClock, SteppingClock and MonotonicClock were shipped under src
with no production use. They now live in the test tree (ADR-0035).

test(infection): widen the mutation gate to the whole domain and wire it into qa

Infection now covers src/F5Sign instead of the Kernel only, with the
persistence code still excluded, and the covered-MSI threshold is part
of the qa script.

test(eidas): add the assurance-tier matrix and a reactor-convergence property test

The eIDAS tier matrix is documented in tests/README.md and the carrier
tests carry #[Group] tags. A new property test asserts that every
reactor converges under duplicated and out-of-order delivery. The cspell
dictionary is extended.

chore(test-standards): reconcile the standard with what was delivered

Updates stale pointers left by the test reshape, applies the two-tier
coverage-attribution rule and makes the standard's own records match the
code.

chore(qa): add the coverage composer scripts

make test-coverage and make test-coverage-text existed without composer
equivalents, contrary to what the docs claimed.

feat(infection): mutate uncovered code, include persistence and gate breadth

Final shape of the Infection config: persistence is no longer excluded,
uncovered code is mutated, and a breadth threshold is checked alongside
covered MSI.
docs(persistence): update the ADRs and live schema for DBAL-only writes (ADR-0018)

build(persistence): drop the Doctrine ORM and rebuild the schema to ADR-0019

The ORM is removed from composer and the bundle list, mappings go away,
and migrations recreate the schema with the ADR-0019 conventions.
refactor(persistence): adapt the domain and phpstan rules to DBAL-only writes
feat(persistence): add DBAL write adapters for Envelope, Session and SE
test(persistence): update the tests for DBAL writes and the new schema
chore(persistence): remaining DBAL-only follow-ups

Merge feat/dbal-only-persistence: writes go through DBAL and the schema follows ADR-0019

The read side was already DBAL, so the two persistence paths collapse
into one and doctrine/orm is no longer a dependency.

chore(gitignore): ignore the public/coverage HTML report

composer coverage can write the HTML report into public/ so it can be
browsed through nginx; it is a build artifact.

ci(backend): build and publish the Docker image from GitHub Actions

Mirrors the signer's build-image workflow: develop pushes :develop and a
v* tag pushes the version and :latest to GHCR. The prod Dockerfile moves
here from the infra repo. The pecl installs are retried so a flaky
channel cannot fail the build, and the Docker and workflow comments are
in English.

docs: bring the backend docs in line with master

The 68 documents are checked against master after the DBAL-only
(ADR-0018) and event-log (ADR-0030, ADR-0031) merges overtook the prose.

feat(session): expose the recipient read model and document download

Two token-scoped GET endpoints for the signer frontend: GET
/api/v1/signing/session returns the recipient read model, and GET
/api/v1/signing/session/documents/{documentId} downloads a document.
Merge branch 'master' into develop

test(session): pin the wire shape of the recipient read endpoints

Also fixes the download controller test, which imported the Clock double
from its old namespace.
Merge feat/session-read-endpoints: the recipient read model and document download

refactor(env): keep development credentials out of the production image

Because .env ships inside the production image and is loaded in every
environment, it carried working dev credentials (DATABASE_URL as
f5sign_app and the broker DSN). Those now come from environment-specific
files.

feat(api): add CORS and structured error logging for the signer

The signer SPA is served from its own origin and calls the API cross-
origin, so the API now answers CORS. Monolog is wired so production logs
the full exception chain, php-fpm worker output is captured, and 5xx
responses are no longer silenced by the exception listener.

refactor(observability): log one structured JSON line per record with request context

Each record carries method, path, tenant and acting user from a Monolog
processor, replacing the multi-line fingers_crossed output.
ApiExceptionListener logs once per exception, keyed to the mapped
status. Also restores the php-fpm healthcheck COPY dropped earlier.
Merge fix/http-error-logging: 5xx responses are logged once with their mapped status

chore(build): silence the php-fpm access log and add a dev Dockerfile target

The /status healthcheck every 10 seconds was flooding the container log.
The Dockerfile gains a dev target so the infra repo builds the
development image from it instead of keeping a second Dockerfile.

test(foundation): pin the CORS boundary and log-context processor, and fix lint

Applies php-cs-fixer to the CORS listener and its test, regenerates the
Monolog config reference, and gives the ApiExceptionListener test the
logger it now requires.

docs(notification): add ADR-0037 and ADR-0038 and the Notification config

Records the supporting-context decision and the template archive, with
the schema and service wiring for the new context.
feat(notification): add the Notification occasion aggregate and delivery application layer
feat(notification): add the email delivery and template archive adapters
test(notification): cover the occasion, delivery and template archive

test(notification): add the remaining Notification, Session and SE tests

Last part of the Notification context, the first consumer of the
templating substrate: tests for its testing doubles and for the Session
and SE reactions.
Merge feat/notification: the Notification context with email and templates

docs(evidence-audit): record the PII tiering decisions and declare the send-time roster

TASK-014 is added for the evidence projector. Envelope send now records
EnvelopeRosterDeclared, the denominator for the evidence reconcile
check, and legally material facts must declare their own severity. A gap
in how attestation documents handle declines is flagged.

feat(session): record consent as its own CONSENT_RECORDED fact

Committing a signature now records a ConsentRecorded event before the
SignatureCommitted act it authorizes, so the envelope stream shows
consent explicitly.

feat(evidence-audit): add the PII classification and cipher substrate (ADR-0032, ADR-0033)

The two decision records and the code they describe, so other
workstreams can build on the same base.
